cues: Bar on your upper back, feet shoulder-width
Sit down between your hips, chest up, to parallel
back-squat.err: Knees caving in: drive them out over your toes

cues: Bar on your front delts, elbows high
Keep your torso upright and sit straight down

cues: Hold the dumbbell at your chest, elbows down
Sit deep, elbows tracking inside your knees

cues: Feet shoulder-width, arms out in front
Sit back, chest up, then drive up through your heels

cues: Feet mid-platform, shoulder-width apart
Lower under control, keep your hips on the pad

cues: Back foot on the bench, weight in your front leg
Drop straight down, then switch legs

cues: Long step, lower until your back knee nearly touches
Push through your front heel and step through

cues: Step back and lower both knees to about 90°
Drive up through your front foot, alternate sides

cues: Whole foot on the box, drive up with that leg
Step down slow and controlled, then switch sides

cues: Back against the pad, roller just above your ankles
Straighten your legs, squeeze, lower slowly

cues: Roller just above your heels, knees by the pivot
Curl all the way in, then lower slowly

cues: Soft knees, push your hips back
Keep the bar close to your legs, back flat

cues: Bar over mid-foot, back tight and flat
Push the floor away, keep the bar close

cues: Dumbbells in front of your thighs, soft knees
Hips back, slide the weights down your legs

cues: Shoulder blades on the bench, feet under your knees
Drive through your heels, squeeze your glutes at the top

cues: On your back, feet hip-width near your glutes
Lift your hips, squeeze, lower slowly

cues: Balls of your feet on the edge, heels free
Rise onto your toes, pause, lower slowly

cues: Hinge back, hike the bell between your legs
Snap your hips forward, arms loose, bell to chest height

cues: Squeeze your shoulder blades, feet planted
Lower to your chest with control, press back up

cues: Bench at 30-45°, shoulder blades pinched
Lower to your upper chest, press up and slightly in

cues: Shoulder blades pinched, dumbbells over your chest
Lower to a stretch, press up and bring them together

cues: Hands under your shoulders, body in a straight line
Lower your chest near the floor, push back up

cues: Knees down, straight line from knees to head
Lower your chest between your hands, push up

cues: Bar on your collarbones, glutes and abs tight
Press overhead, move your head through at the top

cues: Dumbbells at ear height, wrists stacked
Press up without clanging them at the top

cues: Slight bend in your elbows, raise out to the sides
Stop at shoulder height, lower slowly

cues: Back on the pad, handles at chest height
Hug the handles together, squeeze, open slowly

cues: Arms locked on the bars, shoulders down
Lower until your shoulders reach elbow height
dips.err: Shoulders shrugging up: press them down away from ears

cues: Hands on the bench edge, hips close to the bench
Bend your elbows back to 90°, push back up

cues: Elbows pinned to your sides, chest up
Push down to full lockout, let it up slowly

cues: Dumbbell overhead, elbows pointing up
Lower behind your head, then straighten your arms

cues: Overhand grip just outside shoulders, start from a dead hang
Pull your chest to the bar, drive your elbows down

cues: Underhand grip, shoulder-width, from a dead hang
Pull until your chin clears the bar

cues: Chest up, pull the bar to your upper chest
Drive your elbows down and back, control the way up

cues: Hinge forward to about 45°, keep your back flat
Row the bar to your belly button, squeeze your shoulder blades

cues: Hand and knee on the bench, flat back
Pull the dumbbell to your hip, then switch sides

cues: Sit tall, chest up, knees slightly bent
Pull the handle to your stomach, squeeze your shoulder blades

cues: Body straight like a plank, heels on the floor
Pull your chest to the bar, squeeze your shoulder blades

cues: Cable at face height, rope in a neutral grip
Pull toward your forehead, elbows high and wide

cues: Elbows pinned to your sides, wrists straight
Curl up to shoulder height, lower slowly to full extension
barbell-curl.err: Swinging your body to lift: lighten the load and keep elbows still

cues: Elbows close to your sides, palms facing forward
Curl up with control, lower all the way down

cues: Neutral grip, thumbs pointing up
Elbows still, curl to shoulder height, lower slowly
hammer-curl.err: Swinging the weights up: slow down and keep your torso still

cues: Arms straight in front, band at shoulder height
Pull the band to your chest, squeeze your shoulder blades

cues: Elbows under shoulders, straight line head to heels
Squeeze abs and glutes, keep breathing steadily

cues: Elbow under shoulder, feet stacked
Lift your hips into a straight line, then switch sides

cues: Lower back pressed down, arms up, knees at 90°
Extend opposite arm and leg, then alternate

cues: Feet flat, hands behind your head without pulling
Curl your shoulders off the floor, lower slowly

cues: Hang from the bar, shoulders engaged, body still
Bring your knees to your chest, curling your pelvis up

cues: Sit, lean back slightly with a straight back
Rotate your shoulders side to side, not just your arms

cues: High plank, hands under shoulders
Drive your knees to your chest one at a time, steady pace

cues: Lower back pressed down, arms overhead
Lift your shoulders and straight legs, hold still

cues: On all fours, hands under shoulders, knees under hips

cues: Jump your feet out and swing your arms overhead
Jump back to feet together, arms by your sides

cues: Squat down, hands on the floor, jump back to plank
Jump your feet to your hands and explode up into a jump

cues: Run in place, driving your knees up to hip height
Stay tall, pump your arms with the rhythm

cues: Squat down with your chest up
Drive up into a jump, land softly back into the squat

cues: Elbows close to your sides, turn the rope with your wrists
Small, low hops on the balls of your feet

cues: On all fours, arch your back and look up

cues: Long lunge, hand on the floor inside your front foot

cues: Heel forward, leg straight, toes up

cues: On all fours, one hand behind your head

cues: Stand tall, arms relaxed by your sides
Draw big circles with your shoulders, forward then backward

cues: Sink into a full squat, heels down
Chest up, push your knees out with your elbows

cues: Kneel, sit back on your heels, reach your arms forward

cues: Half-kneeling, front foot flat on the floor
Rock your knee past your toes, heel down, then switch sides
